description: Test suite for Expense Claim functionality in ERPNext, including expense calculations, status updates, GL entries, and permissions.

classes.name: TestExpenseClaim
classes.description: Unit tests for Expense Claim features including expense calculations, status, GL entries, and permissions.

methods.name: test_total_expense_claim_for_project
methods.description: Tests calculation of total expense claims for a project and task, including cancellation effects.

methods.name: test_expense_claim_status
methods.description: Tests updating of expense claim status upon bank entry posting and cancellation.

methods.name: test_expense_claim_gl_entry
methods.description: Verifies GL entries generated for an expense claim with taxes.

methods.name: test_rejected_expense_claim
methods.description: Checks behavior of rejected expense claims, ensuring no GL entries are created.

methods.name: test_expense_approver_perms
methods.description: Tests sharing and permission management for expense approvers.

methods.name: test_multiple_payment_entries_against_expense
methods.description: Verifies multiple partial payments against an expense claim and correct outstanding/reimbursed amounts.

methods.name: get_payable_account
methods.description: Retrieves default payable account for a company.

methods.name: generate_taxes
methods.description: Creates tax entries for expense claims.

methods.name: make_expense_claim
methods.description: Creates and optionally submits an expense claim with specified parameters.

methods.name: get_outstanding_and_total_reimbursed_amounts
methods.description: Calculates outstanding and total reimbursed amounts for an expense claim.

methods.name: make_payment_entry
methods.description: Creates and submits a payment entry linked to an expense claim.
